backstory.v: She sets a comfortable pace according to a definition nobody else has seen. Her stopwatch defines comfortable effort with impressive precision and very little consultation. HyperNorm calls residents on pace or falling short. A dissonant card has made her lower the pennant until the smallest neighbour can see it. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Das Tempo ist angenehm. Die Definition wird nicht mitgeführt.

backstory.v: He keeps his last reserve somewhere the rest of him has stopped looking. He keeps a final reserve because the building keeps discovering further finals. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er hat noch Reserven. Der Rest von ihm wurde darüber nicht unterrichtet.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Sie läuft für die Erfahrung. Über deren Länge wurde nicht gesprochen.

Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er kennt das Ziel. Es erscheint nur nicht mehr glaubwürdig.

backstory.v: He is not last; he is maintaining a socially useful distance from the finish. He carries the old shoe because stopping need not mean abandoning the route. The building recognises finishers or obstructions. An ambiguous card has made him wave to the residents watching from their windows; some have started waving back. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er ist fast da. Das Fast erfüllt inzwischen eine soziale Funktion.
